definitions.low_noise_prefix: real blocks 1..L-1 once per sample; actual official RF noised sigma
definitions.per_chunk: one real block value per sample for each chunk_id; no slot0/padding; tail included
definitions.immediate_previous_history: targets k=2..N each contribute block k-1 once; equals real blocks 1..N-1 once per sample
definitions.main_acceptance: expected prefix-replaced share of immediate previous histories is 50%; actual sigma<=0.1 share also includes any native RF suffix draws <=0.1
definitions.excludes: unused slot0, padding, U/S conditioning rows, H15 repeated attention exposure

v03.objective: video + wrist-weighted action (w=3 on wrist pose, w=1 otherwise)
